meta.title: Workspace suite
meta.description: Sidebar suite for workspaces: group existing workspaces into virtual groups that nest arbitrarily deep (a view-only classification — nothing on disk is created or moved), and start one-click temporary sessions that each claim the next numbered tmp-NN directory under ~/.dsh/temp-workspace. Temporary workspaces are pinned into a leading "Temporary workspaces" group: hiding only removes the row (directory and sessions are kept) and the in-group Hidden section restores it. Archived sessions hide behind the header eye toggle. Group data is stored in this browser.
